mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()

SELECT o.id, g.name goodsName, g.images, g.price, o.status, o.create_time createTime, o.buyer_id buyerId, g.user_id sellerId FROM orders o LEFT JOIN goods g ON o.goods_id = g.id WHERE o.buyer_id = #{id} OR g.user_id = #{id} ORDER BY o.create_time DESC

SELECT o.id, o.goods_id AS goodsId, o.buyer_id AS buyerId, o.status, o.pay_time AS payTime, o.finish_time AS finishTime, o.create_time AS createTime, o.update_time AS updateTime,
g.name AS name, g.price AS price, g.detail_info AS detailInfo, g.images AS images,
u.id AS sellerId, u.username AS sellerName, u.avatar_url AS avatarUrl
FROM orders o LEFT JOIN goods g ON o.goods_id = g.id LEFT JOIN user u ON g.user_id = u.id WHERE o.id = #{orderId}
